name: Characteristic-p Yang Dimension / Yang Dimension
details: The proposed uniform domination $\mathrm Y_p\ge\mathrm Y_2$ for every fixed prime $p$ is false, in particular at $p=3$. On the Anchored Torsion Class, $\mathrm Y_3=3<4=\mathrm Y_2$; the same failure holds for every odd prime. This is not a refutation of a reverse affine bound, and $p=2$ is still the default-field identity.
proof_source: Survey Corollary prop:yang-positive-characteristics-unordered refers to the database-owned exact value proofs for the two opposing finite witnesses.
witness_verification: At fixed p=3 the exact values are Y_p=3 and Y_2=4, contradicting the displayed domination. The value proof covers every odd prime, but the gap is finite rather than an unbounded-ratio witness.
